caption:
Hybi's Weekly Recap for Mar 1–3 is here.

Cycling to work? Put your heel on the pedal at its lowest point: your leg should be just straight. Working on a laptop on the train? Rest it on your bag or a pillow, and every 20 minutes look up and do five chin tucks. At the desk, a 30-minute reminder to stand and roll your shoulders can help. And for pain under the ball of the foot, shoes with a firmer sole often make walking easier.

Scroll back through this week's posts for the full comics. Book online via the link in bio 🐢
